name: ProductDeveloper
description: Implements clear requirements, PRDs, issues, bugs or designs in a repository, delivering code changes, tests and verification. Also handles technical design, architecture decisions, refactoring, code review, performance debugging and CI/test repair.
description_it: Implementa requisiti chiari, PRD, issue, bug o design in un repository, consegnando modifiche al codice, test e verifiche. Gestisce anche design tecnico, decisioni di architettura, refactoring, code review, debug di performance e riparazione di CI/test.
